Instant Potato Flakes Bulk for Food Manufacturing and Export

Instant mashed potato brands, snack pellet makers, croquette producers and catering suppliers all rely on potato flakes that rehydrate the same way every time. Tradenest Naturals supplies instant potato flakes bulk to these food manufacturers, as well as to distributors, importers, restaurant groups and private label brands. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The potatoes are cooked, mashed and dehydrated so the flakes keep a clean potato taste and a pale cream color. As a dehydrated potato flakes supplier based in Surat, India, we handle standard bulk supply as well as custom packaging, private label and OEM work. Buyers looking for a bulk dehydrated potato flakes supplier India can request current specifications, packaging details, samples, pricing, and export documentation from Tradenest Naturals. We keep communication direct, batches consistent and supply planned around your volumes.

Product Overview

Dehydrated potato flakes are a shelf-stable potato ingredient made by cooking, mashing, drying, and flaking prepared potatoes. The resulting product can be rehydrated quickly with water, milk, stock, fat, or other formulation ingredients. It offers manufacturers a convenient alternative to fresh potato while reducing peeling, washing, cooking, labor, storage, and processing requirements. The flakes are suitable for industrial formulations and foodservice preparation. They can be used directly in selected recipes or milled and blended with other dry ingredients to achieve the required particle size and performance. Product parameters may be adjusted according to the application, including granulation, color, flavor profile, packaging format, and private label requirements.

Manufacturing and Processing

Tradenest Naturals follows controlled processing steps for uniform, stable product. Selected potatoes are inspected, cleaned, peeled, and prepared before cooking. The cooked potato is mashed and processed through a controlled drying system to remove moisture while preserving the desired potato characteristics. The dried sheet or mass is then flaked, sieved, inspected, and packed in moisture-resistant food-grade packaging.
  • Raw material selection and incoming inspection
  • Cleaning, peeling, trimming, and preparation
  • Controlled cooking and mashing
  • Dehydration and moisture reduction
  • Flaking, sieving, and particle-size control
  • Batch inspection, packing, labeling, and traceability
The standard product is supplied without unnecessary fillers or artificial flavoring unless a customer specifically requests a formulation containing permitted ingredients. Buyers should confirm the final ingredient statement and allergen requirements before commercial production, particularly when the product is intended for a regulated market or a finished retail label.

Typical Technical Specifications

The values below are taken from our product specification sheet, which is shared with every quotation. Color and flavor can vary slightly from crop to crop.
  • Form: Dehydrated potato flakes
  • Typical mesh or granulation: 80-100 mesh
  • Typical moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Shelf life: 12 months in sealed packaging
  • Color: Cream to light yellow
  • Flavor: Clean, characteristic potato flavor
  • Processing: Cooked, mashed, dehydrated, flaked, and sieved
  • Foreign matter: Controlled according to internal quality procedures and agreed specification
Please confirm your allergen and analytical requirements for the destination market and intended use. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Batch information and export documentation support are provided with each shipment.

Applications

Instant potato flakes are valued for their fast rehydration, neutral culinary base, and ability to provide body and potato flavor in dry and wet formulations. Typical applications include:
  • Instant mashed potato and potato puree mixes
  • Potato croquettes, patties, cutlets, and nuggets
  • Snack pellets, extruded snacks, and savory snack systems
  • Soup, sauce, gravy, and convenience-food formulations
  • Bakery products, potato breads, rolls, and dough systems
  • Coating, binding, and bulking systems for prepared foods
  • Ready-to-cook meals and institutional foodservice products
  • Seasoned potato mixes and private label instant food products

Buyer Value

For industrial and foodservice buyers, dehydrated potato flakes can simplify procurement and production planning. The product provides a practical way to access potato functionality without managing the short shelf life and variable preparation requirements associated with fresh potatoes.
  • Operational efficiency: Reduces peeling, washing, cooking, and kitchen preparation work.
  • Longer storage potential: A low-moisture format supports extended shelf life when properly packed and stored.
  • Consistent formulation: Helps standardize texture, solids, and potato input across production batches.
  • Lower handling requirements: Dry flakes are easier to warehouse, portion, transport, and incorporate into dry mixes.
  • Fast preparation: Rehydrates efficiently for instant and ready-to-cook applications.
  • Flexible commercial supply: Available in bulk, wholesale, export, and private label formats.

Quality, Packaging, and Shelf Life

Products are packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials selected for the order size and destination. Packaging is designed to help protect the flakes from humidity, contamination, light exposure, and physical damage during warehousing and transportation. Labels can include product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage conditions, and applicable regulatory information. Standard packaging may include 1 kg and 5 kg packs for foodservice or small-scale production, 10 kg and 25 kg bags for wholesale use, and larger bulk bags for industrial buyers. Stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, export cartons, and custom printed private label packaging can be evaluated according to volume, filling requirements, and market regulations. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and is stored under recommended conditions. The shelf life is printed on every label. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, heat, strong odors, moisture, and pests. Reseal opened packs promptly and use clean, dry handling equipment.

Wholesale and Export Supply

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed dehydrated potato flakes manufacturer, wholesale supplier and IEC registered exporter in India. We work with importers, distributors, food processors, FMCG companies, restaurant chains, cloud kitchens, hotels, and private label businesses. Our team can review destination-country labeling, packaging, documentation, palletization, and product specification needs before confirming the order. Buyers comparing dehydrated potato flakes price should provide the required quantity, mesh or granulation, packaging, destination port, delivery terms, and any special quality or labeling requirements. Pricing is influenced by potato availability, order volume, packaging material, customization, freight, and documentation. Larger wholesale quantities usually bring a lower landed cost per kilo.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity for instant potato flakes bulk?

The MOQ is 5 Kg, which keeps trial orders simple. Samples are available on request. Private label, custom formulation and printed packaging orders need extra planning, which we confirm after reviewing your inquiry.

What quality documents do you provide?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. We follow raw material inspection, moisture control, batch traceability and hygienic processing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

Options include bulk export bags, 25 kg and 10 kg wholesale packs, 5 kg and 1 kg foodservice packs, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and private label formats. Typical shelf life is 12 months in unopened, moisture-protected packaging under suitable storage conditions.

What are the typical specifications?

Our dehydrated potato flakes are cream to light yellow with a clean potato flavor, 80-100 mesh granulation and moisture ≤ 8%. The standard format has no additives. Final specifications are confirmed on the product specification sheet.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on quantity and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Custom or private label orders may require additional time for artwork approval, material procurement, and production planning. To request a sample or quote, send the required quantity, application, packaging preference, destination country or port, target specification, and labeling requirements. Tradenest Naturals will respond with availability, sample options, commercial pricing, lead time, and relevant documentation.

Request a Commercial Offer

Contact Tradenest Naturals for instant potato flakes bulk pricing, samples, technical specifications, export packaging, private label supply, or long-term wholesale contracts. Each buyer gets a clear specification, a 5 Kg MOQ, direct communication and a supply plan built around the intended market and application.
